pattern: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch"> with a <label for> association (WAI-ARIA APG Switch).

roles.role: switch (explicit on a native checkbox; checked state maps to on/off)

aria.value: Help text and visible error message ids
"true" only while a custom error message is shown

keyboard.action: Moves focus to and from the switch.

focus: The native input (the track) is the focus target and shows a color-focus-ring outline on :focus-visible.
notes: The state is shown by the thumb position as well as by color.
Clicking the label toggles the switch, extending the hit target.
Enter does not toggle (native checkbox behavior); Space does.
Switches have no required state; a failed save can be reported with setCustomError.
knownCaveats: Screen-reader announcement of role=switch on/off has not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
